title: Fact
description: Represents an assertion linking a person to a source document for a specific historical reason, utilizing centralized shared definitions.

fact_type.description: [REQUIRED] Standardized category of the historical fact assertion.

date.description: [OPTIONAL] Genealogical date for the fact or null.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Human- and AI-readable contextual display string summarizing the asserted fact (e.g., 'Death of Annie Lehman', 'Marriage of William Lehman and Annie Myers').

notes.description: [OPTIONAL] Research notes, conflict analysis, or transcription quirks (excluding individual names to prevent data drift).

life_story.description: [OPTIONAL] Qualitative narrative describing the human context of the event.

associated_people.description: [OPTIONAL] List of other individuals involved in this event and their specific roles.

external_identifiers.description: [OPTIONAL] Cross-reference mapping to external GEDCOM events and sources.

created_at.description: [REQUIRED] ISO 8601 timestamp tracking when the fact entry was first created.

updated_at.description: [REQUIRED] ISO 8601 timestamp tracking when the fact entry was last modified. Matches created_at on initial insertion.

source.description: [REQUIRED] Primary source reference pairing archival URNs with physical filenames.
